NYISO.note: Frontier achieved: the deep >$300 tail's two candidate reserve levers are chased to ground — the largest-contingency requirement formula is already in the model as the measured NYCA families, and the ORDC/RCPF stack is verified complete and SOM-grounded (fires to VOLL in 2023).
